## Overview

Metastasis analyses are restricted to bone so that pre- and on-treatment comparisons stay within a single tissue microenvironment. The script reads the laboratory tissue annotation and reshapes it to one row per patient × timepoint. It then removes every sample whose region summary documents a lymph-node or other soft-tissue lesion, together with the PMC-015 archival block, which came from an obturator lymph node rather than the prostate.

Bone-only copies of the three input objects (raw counts, the QC-annotated object and the QC-filtered object) are written to `data/`, where every downstream script reads them. Per the manuscript, this removed ten metastasis biopsies and one archival block (107 AOIs), and one patient whose only profiled tissue was a lymph node, leaving 32 patients.

**Manuscript items supported**

- Methods: Patients, samples and outcomes (restriction to bone metastases and exclusion of lymph-node and soft-tissue samples)
- Intermediate results used by every downstream script (bone-only input objects)

**Pipeline step:** `./run_pipeline.sh --only 00b_bone_cohort`. Approximate runtime: under a minute.

**Inputs**

- `data/metadata/PRINCE_DSP Tissue Annotation_02122024_CLWSv2.xlsx`
- `data/raw/PRINCE_GeoMx_SE_RawCount_SampleAnnot_Filtered.qs`
- `data/interim/phase2_se_with_qc_metrics.qs`
- `data/interim/phase2_se_qc_filtered.qs`

**Outputs**

- `results/C0_bone_cohort/documented_tissue_site.csv`
- `results/C0_bone_cohort/dropped_nonbone_samples.csv`
- `results/C0_bone_cohort/aoi_counts.csv`
- `data/PRINCE_GeoMx_SE_RawCount_SampleAnnot_Filtered.qs`
- `data/phase2_se_with_qc_metrics.qs`
- `data/phase2_se_qc_filtered.qs`

**Depends on**: `comp_00a_qc`

## Analysis

Script header: why the metastatic analyses are restricted to bone, and which inputs and outputs are involved.

Sources the shared set-up and loads packages.

```{r comp-00b-bone-cohort-01}
## ============================================================================
## PRINCE -- C0b: define the bone-only analysis cohort
## Metastasis analyses use bone biopsies only. Every sample documented as a
## lymph-node or soft-tissue lesion is removed, as is the PMC-015 Archival block
## (an obturator lymph node rather than prostate).
## Inputs : data/metadata/PRINCE_DSP Tissue Annotation_02122024_CLWSv2.xlsx (lab tissue annotation)
##          data/raw/PRINCE_GeoMx_SE_RawCount_SampleAnnot_Filtered.qs (all sites)
##          data/interim/phase2_se_{with_qc_metrics,qc_filtered}.qs (all sites, from comp_00a_qc)
## Outputs: results/C0_bone_cohort/{documented_tissue_site,dropped_nonbone_samples,aoi_counts}.csv
##          data/{PRINCE_GeoMx_SE_RawCount_SampleAnnot_Filtered,phase2_se_with_qc_metrics,phase2_se_qc_filtered}.qs
##          (bone-only versions read by every downstream analysis)
## ============================================================================

source(file.path(Sys.getenv("PRINCE_ROOT", "."), ".build", "comp_00_guard.R"))
suppressMessages({ library(qs); library(SummarizedExperiment); library(readxl) })

```

### Documented tissue site
Reads the laboratory tissue annotation and builds one record per patient × timepoint (Archival, Screening, Cycle1, DiseaseProgression), with block, region and region summary. Timepoints without a documented region are skipped.

```{r comp-00b-bone-cohort-02}
## ---- documented tissue site per sample (lab annotation) ---------------------------------------------
ann <- read_excel(file.path(PRINCE_DIR, "metadata", "PRINCE_DSP Tissue Annotation_02122024_CLWSv2.xlsx"), sheet = 1)
ann <- as.data.frame(ann, check.names = FALSE)
tp_cols <- list(Archival = c("ARCHIVAL-A", "REGION-A", "REGION-A_summary"),
                Screening = c("SCREENING-SCR", "REGION-SCR", "REGION-SCR_summary"),
                Cycle1 = c("CYCLE 1-C1", "REGION-C1", "REGION-C1_summary"),
                DiseaseProgression = c("PD", "REGION-PD", "REGION-PD_summary"))
site <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(ann)), function(i) do.call(rbind, lapply(names(tp_cols), function(tp) {
  cc <- tp_cols[[tp]]; reg <- ann[i, cc[2]]
  if (is.na(reg) || reg == "NA") return(NULL)
  data.frame(subject_id = sub("^PRI-", "", ann$ID[i]), timepoint = tp, block = ann[i, cc[1]],
             region = reg, region_summary = ann[i, cc[3]])
}))))

```

### Samples to exclude
Marks which annotated samples are present in the GeoMx data. The exclusion key is every patient × timepoint whose region summary contains LYMPH or OTHER, plus `PMC-015 Archival`. Writes the site table and the exclusion list.

```{r comp-00b-bone-cohort-03}
## ---- samples to drop: documented lymph-node or other soft-tissue lesions + PMC-015 Archival --------
se_raw <- qread(file.path(PRINCE_DIR, "raw", "PRINCE_GeoMx_SE_RawCount_SampleAnnot_Filtered.qs"))
site$in_geomx_data <- paste(site$subject_id, site$timepoint) %in% paste(se_raw$subject_id, se_raw$timepoint)
nb <- site[grepl("LYMPH|OTHER", site$region_summary), c("subject_id", "timepoint")]
drop_key <- c(paste(nb$subject_id, nb$timepoint), "PMC-015 Archival")
write.csv(site, out_path("C0_bone_cohort", "documented_tissue_site.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data.frame(key = drop_key), out_path("C0_bone_cohort", "dropped_nonbone_samples.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Samples excluded (documented non-bone metastasis or lymph-node archival block):\n"); print(drop_key)

```

### Bone-only input objects
For each of the three input objects, drops AOIs whose patient × timepoint is in the exclusion key, saves the bone-only version to `data/` and records AOI counts before and after.

```{r comp-00b-bone-cohort-04}
## ---- write bone-only versions of the three input objects ----------------------------------------------
cnt <- list()
for (f in c("PRINCE_GeoMx_SE_RawCount_SampleAnnot_Filtered.qs", "phase2_se_with_qc_metrics.qs", "phase2_se_qc_filtered.qs")) {
  src <- if (startsWith(f, "phase2")) file.path(PRINCE_DIR, "interim", f) else file.path(PRINCE_DIR, "raw", f)
  se <- qread(src); key <- paste(se$subject_id, se$timepoint)
  drop <- key %in% drop_key
  cat(f, ": dropping", sum(drop), "of", ncol(se), "AOIs\n")
  qsave(se[, !drop], file.path(PRINCE_DIR, f))
  cnt[[f]] <- data.frame(object = f, aois_all = ncol(se), aois_dropped = sum(drop), aois_kept = sum(!drop))
}
write.csv(do.call(rbind, cnt), out_path("C0_bone_cohort", "aoi_counts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
